patch_description: This design retains the reliable local RY mixers and ring connectivity seen in the strongest candidates, but replaces both the fully collective phase and the parameter-heavy independent phase layer with a low-rank antipodal phase field. Four RZ parameters are shared across opposite qubits, preserving useful half-turn structure while allowing substantially more phase resolution than a single collective parameter. Placing the mixer before two interleaved CZ matchings ensures that every useful phase field lies between population-mixing layers across repeated blocks. The resulting circuit uses 12 parameters per block (74 total), a compromise intended to recover the lower validation loss of the 98-parameter ansatz while retaining stronger parameter efficiency and regularization.
